keywords: Verification process 2.Problem-solving process 3.Basic skills 4.Data handling skills 5.PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions. -To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively. -To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events. -To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities. -To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice: In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes. This course will deal with characteristic things of corresponding department. One is that the students will learn basics of “data-handling skills” needed for collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis → visualization → report. One is that the students will learn basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities. By the experiment of the field of building structure, students perform the strength examination of the paper structure which students made by a team. Students put the structure which students made between the fulcrums of 40cm in a structure object similar to a bridge, and loading does a weight at the center. Students compete with weight before a structure collapsing for durability time. Students make the structure from the design characteristics of the shape and a structural mechanics-like viewpoint using paper material. Students make an insulation material of 15cm *15cm at thickness 3cm every team and, by the experiment of the field of building environment, measure the insulation performance. The insulation performance measures a heat flux level or surface temperature and calculates it using the data. The material to use for an insulation material concentrates an idea every team and devises composition of the material.
requiredKnowledge: By the experiment of the structure, students need drafting ability to describe basic knowledge of the dynamics of the physics, the simple plan of the structure which students made in. By the experiment of the insulation material, students need a technique of EXCEL dealing with the thermal knowledge and measurement data with the textbook which students appointed.

achievementLevels.standard: 1) To be able to proceed with activities from problem-finding to solution with guidance by instructor. 2) To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events with guidance. 3) To be able to recognize characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, and events with guidance. 4) To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person. 5) To be able to conduct verification activities with guidance. 6) To be able to recognize the identity of the major (department) and be proud with guidance.
